subject: Close timeline drift — forensic triage & owner lattice
messages:
From: Lauren Finch <lauren.finch@stellaris.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@stellaris.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 Sep 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Concern: evaluation blockers pushing close beyond 9/30

Marissa —

Quick note from our side: the internal eval team hit a blocker yesterday during a sustained-load run. Several prompts regressed on hallucination checks and the security team has outstanding questions about KV cache retention. Those two items together mean we can’t sign off on the eval gate on 9/25 and that pushes our expected close past 9/30 unless we do a few things in parallel.

I attached the evaluation-summary-v3.pdf with the failing cases and a short log. Can your team help with a triage session early next week? We also need a revised MAP that calls out owners for remediation tasks and a transparent timeline for the extended eval window.

Availability: I can do Mon 9/17 10–11 PDT or Tue 9/18 13–14 PDT. Procurement will need a heads-up on any date shift as they have internal approvals tied to month-end.

Thanks,
Lauren Finch
Director, Platform Evaluation
Stellaris AI

Attachments: evaluation-summary-v3.pdf (9 pages, annotated)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Finch <lauren.finch@stellaris.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Sep 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Concern: evaluation blockers pushing close beyond 9/30

Lauren —

Thanks for the detailed log. I reviewed the attachment and flagged two distinct workstreams: (A) model-behavior fixes (prompt-sets and safety filters) and (B) infra/retention for KV cache. To avoid a single-point delay we should run those in parallel with clear owners and acceptance criteria.

Proposed immediate actions:
- Triage call to go through the failing cases (I can take Mon 9/17 10:00 PDT).
- Ben will own the behavioral remediation scope; Jonas will own the infra/retention follow-through.
- I will circulate a MAP-diff-0920.xlsx that shows the current MAP vs proposed parallel lanes; this will include a provisional re-baseline (adds 10 business days to the eval window) and an accelerated hotfix lane.

Ben / Jonas — please confirm you can take these owners and list any blockers (access, test harness, SSO).

Lauren — if procurement needs to see the re-baselined dates formally I will include a one-pager for their approval cycle after we align on owners.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP-diff-0920.xlsx (spreadsheet: delta vs current MAP)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Sep 2028 11:36:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Concern: evaluation blockers pushing close beyond 9/30

Marissa / Jonas —

I confirm I will lead the prompt-set remediation. Immediate ask for the triage call: can Lauren share the exact prompt variants and seed data used for the sustained-run? That will let us reproduce regressions in our harness. If we can reproduce Monday, I estimate a 3–5 business day remediation plus a 2-day verification loop with their eval team (assuming no infra churn).

Blockers: I need API keys scoped to the eval harness (read-only) and a copy of their prompt seed with redacted PII. If SSO is slow, I’ll start with a local replay.

I’ll prepare a short remediation checklist and add it to the MAP-diff sheet after the triage call.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Architect, Redwood Dedicated
From: Lauren Finch <lauren.finch@stellaris.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@stellaris.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 Sep 2028 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Concern: evaluation blockers pushing close beyond 9/30

Marissa —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. We did the triage call today and confirmed Ben could reproduce three of the five failing cases (great). Security still needs clarification on KV retention windows — I attached the security-qa-answers.xlsx with our annotated questions.

Procurement asked that we formally extend the evaluation window by two weeks to allow remediation and a follow-up verification run. They will start the approvals if you can send a revised MAP this week.

We’re ok with the owners as proposed (Ben for behavior, Jonas for infra) and can provision a temporary eval API key if SSO is a blocker. Please include the approval path and DocuSign timeline in the MAP.

Regards,
Lauren

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Finch <lauren.finch@stellaris.ai>, Procurement Team <procurement@stellaris.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 Sep 2028 16:23:00 -0700
Subject: Close drift remediation plan and escalation snapshot (exec view)

Team —

This thread is the formal record of the respins for the Stellaris eval slip. Summary and next steps (exec view):

1) Risk snapshot:
- Root causes: model prompt regression (medium) + KV cache retention clarification (high for sign-off).
- Impact: estimated close slip from 2028-09-30 to 2028-10-14 if remediation proceeds on current cadence. If remediation encounters infra gating then slip could be larger.

2) Re-baseline and owners (committed):
- Behavioral remediation (owner: ben_carter) — target deploy to staging: 2028-09-25, verification windows: 9/26–9/28. Acceptance: 95% reduction in hallucination score on provided seed.
- KV retention + security clarifications (owner: jonas_weber) — target config change & doc update: 2028-09-27; security answers and log retention proof: 2028-09-29.
- Procurement/contract path (owner: marissa_cole) — send updated MAP + one-pager for approvals and DocuSign term-sheet by 2028-09-21 EOD.

3) Escalation lanes:
- If KV retention proof is not available by 2028-09-29, I will escalate to Platform Ops leadership and request a temporary SLA exception to allow a controlled cutover for the verification run.
- If behavioral fixes exceed 5 business days beyond the target, we will convene a 48-hour warroom with Stellaris execs to evaluate scope reduction or partial go-live paths.

4) Links / artifacts for approvers:
- HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.company/contacts/STEL-1457
- MAP (delta): https://drive.company.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-MAPs
- Term-sheet (DocuSign): https://app.docusign.com/packet/STEL-1457/term-sheet

Next steps for today: I’ll draft the procurement-facing MAP and circulate by EOD 9/20. Ben — ping me the final verification checklist. Jonas — confirm the exact log artifacts you’ll produce for security.

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
